scope: Read-only independent native EcoCyc authority contract review of three root-accepted originals, recorded acquisition receipts and current source/configuration boundary. No tests, network, Git mutation, maintained mutation, shared cache mutation or implementation acceptance.

support_boundary.searched: src, scripts, conf, tests, docs with rg -n -uu -L, excluding binary Python caches and generated HTML; ignored and hidden files and symlink targets included. This is a scoped runtime/configuration absence claim, not absence of all EcoCyc references in the repository.
found: GO-CAM external type recognition and UniProt BioCyc cofactor cross-reference logic already mention EcoCyc. These do not establish a native EcoCyc source-backed identifier authority.

Current source builder SOURCE_NAMESPACES and source kind dispatch have no native EcoCyc authority; native and closed schema prefix enumerations, source-backed policy and public citation route require matching new support.

authentic_fields.all_three: ISO-8859-1 XML declaration; ptools-xml ptools-version 27.0; exactly metadata then one full Protein or RNA; ECOLI PGDB version 27.0, Escherichia coli, K-12 substr. MG1655, NCBI-TAXONOMY-DB unification 511145. Full direct observations and original byte hashes are in native-observations.json.

CPLX0-226.components: PC00004 and CAMP; no coefficients. Never infer CAMP occupancy.

contract_recommendations: Transport/request: allow exact evidenced HTTPS host bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr and /getxml request with one id=ECOLI:FRAME. Require conservative local frame syntax, exact case, no credentials, fragment, whitespace, extraneous query or alternative port. Do not infer permission to use other hosts or HTTP transport from a serialized URL.

Serializer compatibility: authentic xml:base is exactly http://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr:443/getxml?ECOLI:FRAME, and metadata/url is exactly http://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr:443/. Support these as explicit source serialization forms tied to the evidenced HTTPS request and matching frame. Do not use generic host-only http/https or arbitrary-port equivalence; changes need authentic evidence.

Parse the original bytes using the declared XML encoding. Reject DOCTYPE and entities at parser level, including UTF-16 encodings, and reject error/HTML roots. Require one metadata and one direct full requested entity, no additional direct object, matching ID/orgid/frameid/detail and no class/resource substitution.

Require one exact service_name getxml, query ECOLI:FRAME, num_results 1, PGDB ECOLI version 27.0 and matching ptools-version 27.0; one species and strain native string, and one exact taxonomy dblink/database/oid/relationship for NCBITaxon:511145. Do not confuse PGDB version, Pathway Tools version or acquisition date.

Use distinct ecocyc-protein-xml and ecocyc-rna-xml source kinds. Verify an exact direct native parent reference whose entity tag/orgid/resource/frameid/class agree. The evidenced protein parents are Protein-Complexes and Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes; evidenced RNA parent is Regulatory-RNAs. Additional protein classes should require final authentic issuing objects, not an unreviewed broad fallback.

Require exactly one direct common-name datatype string, no nested XML children, nonempty safe resolved text, and no native frame/ECOLI frame/EcoCyc ID fallback or placeholders. Reuse safe character/markup validation carefully while leaving existing MetaCyc behavior unchanged. No activity fallback or recursive descendant name selection.

Only direct native synonym datatype string slots may become aliases. Validate each with the same nonempty safe resolved text checks; malformed aliases must fail the source, not be skipped. Do not promote genes, publications, nested complex names, database cross-references or sequence/component facts into identity aliases.

Before filtering for corpus IDs, reject duplicate-source conflicts on native type, parent class, canonical name, canonicalized alias set, PGDB/release/taxon/species/strain assertions. Prevent non-EcoCyc source kinds from smuggling EcoCyc authority entries. Preserve preexisting authority snapshot values and metadata completely.

Add EcoCyc with exact casing to all native/closed schema patterns and allowed prefixes, SOURCE_NAMESPACES, source-backed policy and citation resolver. canonical_or_synonym is justified only for validated direct aliases; no contextual-label exception or MetaCyc alias.

Citation route is https://ecocyc.org/gene?id=LOCAL_ID, from root-accepted proposal and its Bioregistry/GO registry review. No independent network revalidation was performed here. Restrict local IDs or encode safely; do not route these proteins/RNA through a MetaCyc pathway URL.

Keep explicit participant category rna for SgrS and complex for both CRP assemblies. Existing KGX explicit categories map to biolink:RNAProduct and biolink:MacromolecularComplex. Existing graph retains declared rna/complex type labels, although RNA uses the generic participant shape and complexes use the shared Protein / complex visual style. No prefix-wide EcoCyc biochemical reaction category is supported; unqualified objects should not gain inferred RNA/protein/reaction semantics.
required_followup_validation: Authentic positives for all three bodies, plus any author-justified additional native objects; retain full original hashes and acquisition receipts.

Meaningful mutation negatives for transport/base/service/query/PGDB/version/taxon/species/strain, missing/duplicate fields, RNA/protein/gene/parent substitution, DTD/entity or HTML input, malformed names/synonyms and duplicate assertions before selection.

Real CLI negative controls must prove absent output remains absent and existing output remains unchanged; source original bytes remain exact. Tests must assert schema/policy parity, exact citation routes and explicit graph/KGX rna/complex categories.

Full retained source snapshot preservation includes historical unused IDs, not only current corpus-selected terms. Verify all source metadata values and original cache hashes, and run focused legacy MetaCyc tests unchanged.

Implementation must capture the root-provided exact combined baseline once ready. This contract review binds only bytes read now and does not constitute combined code, record science, regulatory truth, CI, merge or publication acceptance.
limits: No new regulatory assertion, component coefficient or molecular occupancy is established by this adapter review.
The failed META request bodies are not EcoCyc issuing positives and must not be reinterpreted as META identities.
Raw originals and articles belong in external evidence/cache, not maintained records.
No tests or network calls were run; acceptance of a concrete implementation remains independent work.
